t: ProTeGi: Prompt Optimization via Textual Gradients
s: Prompt Optimization with Textual Gradients (ProTeGi) designates a family of techniques for improving discrete or continuous prompt variables driving black-box LLMs and related AI systems, using rich, model-generated natural language feedback as an interpretable analogue of numeric gradients.
